channel.description: Plain-language updates for AI developer tools.

item.title: Usage 0.34.25
item.description: Button and Usage Unit Display Fixes Across All Panels: Looking at the numbers and buttons in a panel used to leave you unsure how many days were counted or what the unit was.

item.title: Usage 0.34.24
item.description: New "Maple Dusk" panel theme: If you want a sunset palette for the panel you open every day, there are now 17 themes to choose from.

item.title: Usage 0.34.23
item.description: More accurate history in reports and the year ledger: When checking past usage in historical reports, you no longer have to worry about numbers getting stuck on old records or overwritten.

item.title: Usage 0.34.22
item.description: Windows tray tooltip drops hidden tools: Hovering over the Windows tray icon to check each tool's quota used to cut off the tools at the end.
